words: former
/ˈfɔːmə/ adj. 以前的，从前的（用于指某人或某物过去的状态或职位）
defeat

election

retire

political
/pəˈlɪtɪkl/ adj. 政治的（与政府、政治活动相关的）
abroad
/əˈbrɔːd/ adv. 到国外，在国外（指去往或身处其他国家）
fanatical
/fəˈnætɪkl/ adj. 狂热的（形容对某事物极度热衷甚至不理智）
opponent

suspicious

entrance

policeman

phrases: 继续做某事，反复做某事
He kept on asking the same question.
The day after, Patrick went to the house again.
第二天，Patrick又去了那所房子。
On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
第二天Patrick又去了那所房子。
He has gone to live abroad.
Mr. Lane was defeated in the recent elections.
Lane先生在最近的选举中败北了。
He is retiring from political life.

grammar.d: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态 描述过去发生的事情，如已完成的选举结果、去过的地点等
ex: Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
The policeman told him that Mr. Lane had gone abroad.
警察告诉他Lane先生已经出国了。

grammar.d: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作 描述过去正在发生的动作，通常与一般过去时连用
ex: The policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance.
While I was reading, the phone rang.
我正在看书时，电话响了。

grammar.k: 直接引语和间接引语 (Direct and Indirect Speech)
grammar.f: 直接引语用引号；间接引语用that引导
grammar.d: 直接引用原话为直接引语；转述别人的话为间接引语 转述他人说的话时使用，过去时态中时间状语需要相应调整
ex: 'Mr. Lane was defeated in the elections,' he shouted.
他在喊：'Lane先生在选举中败北了。'
He told me that Mr. Lane had been defeated in the elections.
他告诉我Lane先生在选举中败北了。

patterns.p: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing when + 主语 + 动词过去式
o: The policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance when Patrick asked the same question.
警察正慢慢走过门口时，Patrick问了同样的问题。
im: I was reading a book when the doorbell rang.
我正在看书时门铃响了。
She was cooking dinner when I arrived home.
我到家时她正在做晚饭。

o: I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday.
我昨天和前天都告诉你了。
im: I told you many times to be careful.
我告诉过你很多次要小心。
I told you he would come late.

o: I know, but I love to hear you say it!
我知道，但我就是爱听你说！
im: I know it's expensive, but it's worth it.
I know you're busy, but could you help me?
我知道你很忙，但你能帮我吗？

o: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman told him...
当他问Lane先生是否住在那里时，警察告诉他...
im: She asked if I was free tomorrow.
He asked if the train had already left.
他问火车是否已经开走了。
